ALL IN CAPITAL | INBOUND APPLICATION
Application Form Response
Submitted through the fund's public application form. Responses are reproduced as the applicant wrote them.
Company
Company name EarnWise (EarnWise Financial Technologies Pvt. Ltd.)
Website www.earnwise.example
Location Gurugram, Haryana
Incorporated January 2026
One-line description Earned wage access for gig and shift workers.
Sector (as selected) Fintech
Stage (as selected) Pre-seed
Team size 5 (founder, 2 outsourced developers, 1 operations, 1 sales)
Founders
Founder Rohit Arora, Founder and CEO. Summer analyst internship (10 weeks) at
an investment bank. 5-month contract role through a vendor at a large
technology company. MBA at a tier-2 business school (2022 to 2024). 18
months at a payments startup. linkedin.com/in/rohit-arora-example
Time commitment Full-time since January 2026.
Prior startup experience 18 months as an employee at a payments startup.
Earlier co-founder A co-founder left in July 2026 and has moved on.
Equity split Founder 85%, one angel 15%.
Product and traction
What have you built? A web and mobile app that lets workers withdraw up to 50% of earned
wages. The employer deducts the advance at payroll.
Customers 1 enterprise client live and 2 in pilot.
Workers 1,600 workers enabled.
Advances INR 38 L disbursed since July 2026.
Funding of advances Advances are funded by our partner NBFC's balance sheet under an
agreement in principle, and partly by the founder's savings.
Customer acquisition Direct outreach by the founder to HR heads.
Key risks Regulation of digital lending and employer payroll integration.
Fundraising
Amount raising INR 2 Cr

Valuation expectation INR 12 Cr post-money
Existing investors One angel, INR 25 L.
Use of funds Advances book, sales, team.
Other investors in
conversation
None.
How did you hear about us? Public application form.
Anything else we should know?
We have a strong market and we are moving fast.
